pages.text: Miniature Immortal Ruin stacks to one. Place it as an unbreakable, non-colliding partial block. Empty-hand use reverses both field state and black/white rendering.
It attracts non-player living entities in a 13x13x13 region. Use directly for settings and sneak-use empty-handed to reverse. Reverse mode converts Teleport force to None. Sneak-wrench dismantles it.
Surround a Miniature Immortal Ruin with Nurturing Crystal and Crying Obsidian. The stabilized block has 54 inventory slots.
The stabilized filter panel has a 5x4 ghost grid, Data Component matching and whitelist/blacklist modes. JEI and EMI ingredients can be dragged into it.

Normal mode collects every dropped item in the selected area. Sneak-use empty-handed reverses it: size is fixed to 1x1x1 and the first occupied slot is dropped into an air target or inserted directly into a NeoForge item storage.

Wrench-use two opposite-state ruins of the same type to link them; a white line appears while holding the wrench. Stabilized links share one 54-slot inventory. Ordinary links can enable Warp on the attractor to send living entities and drops to the reversed endpoint every tick.
